name: gravity-rail
description: Gravity Rail — a 3D machine-building physics puzzle game for the browser.

scripts.build:crazygames: tsc --noEmit && vite build --outDir dist-crazygames --mode crazygames && node scripts/zip.mjs dist-crazygames gravity-rail-crazygames.zip
scripts.build:playgama: tsc --noEmit && vite build --outDir dist-playgama --mode playgama && node scripts/zip.mjs dist-playgama gravity-rail-playgama.zip
